name: familyhouse_exterior_tree
description: A shady spot beneath the old tree along the cobblestone path, with the cozy cottage’s terracotta roof, soft-brown wood walls, and sage shutters barely visible in the far background.

color_palette: Leafy green (#6B8E23) for the canopy leaves and low grass underfoot.
Weathered bark brown (#8B5A2B) for the tree trunk and branches, and cool cobblestone gray (#7D7D7D) for the path stones.
Far-background house accents: soft sage green (#8A9A5B) shutters, warm terracotta (#CC7357) roof tiles, and soft brown (#D69242) natural wood siding.
visual_style.architectural_style: A natural outdoor vignette beneath a broad-limbed tree beside the cobblestone path that leads to the cottage. When glimpsed, the cottage matches the main exterior: pitched roof with wide eaves and terracotta tiles, shuttered windows, natural wood siding in soft brown, a tiny front porch, and a low stone foundation; framing stays low to a child’s eye level with adults cropped at elbows and below.
visual_style.flora_fauna: Clover, dandelions, and lavender peep through the grass; butterflies, ladybugs, and robins visit, while a curious squirrel may perch on a low branch.
materials: Rounded cobblestone path of gray stones curving past the tree
Rough-barked hardwood tree with sturdy low branches and dense leaves
Simple wooden fence slats and small terracotta pots near the path
Distant cottage details: terracotta roof tiles, soft brown natural wood siding with soft sage shutters, a low stone foundation, and a tiny front porch
